name: Miyakanbai Hi no Shizuku Strawberry Sake

producer.name: Kanbai Shuzo
producer.about: Kanbai Shuzo is in Furukawa, Osaki, Miyagi. A landowner named Iwasaki founded the brewery in 1918. Production stopped for a time during the war, and the company was re-established in 1957. It has stayed in family hands.
